note: Wallis and Futuna, read 2026-10-31. Majority: France's civil code sets majority at 18 (art. 414, as service-public.gouv.fr states it), but Wallis and Futuna is governed under the 1961 statute (loi n° 61-814 of 29 July 1961) with legislative speciality and its people's customary personal status guaranteed; whether art. 414 applies there as of right, and to those under customary status, wasn't found in a text this client could read (Légifrance refuses it), so majority is null. Work: the labour code that applies is the overseas labour code of 1952 (loi n° 52-1322 du 15 décembre 1952, as amended), as the territory's labour inspectorate's guide (Service de l'Inspection du travail et des affaires sociales, July 2014, wallis-et-futuna.gouv.fr) states; the US Department of Labor's 2024 report puts the minimum age for work at 16 under its art. 118, but the article itself wasn't read and nothing was found on young performers, so work is null. Service: France's military service was suspended in 1996 (the Ministry of the Armed Forces' press kit on the new service national, read 2026-10-31: the new service, ten months for volunteers of 18 to 25 from 2026, has no compulsory character), so service is none; the citizen census at 16 and the defence and citizenship day (JDC, renamed the journée de mobilisation) remain duties of every young French national, which the form doesn't hold. Wallisians and Futunians are French nationals, so it binds them as it binds every French national.

sources.title: Émancipation d'un mineur (service-public.gouv.fr, the French administration's official information, DILA)
sources.said: Un mineur est émancipé automatiquement par le mariage, quel que soit son âge. ... mais il reste juridiquement mineur jusqu’à ses 18 ans révolus.

sources.said: Contrairement à l’ancien service suspendu en 1996, il n’a aucun caractère obligatoire. ... Le service national s’adresse aux jeunes Françaises et Français volontaires âgés de 18 à 25 ... Durée du service : 10 mois, dont un mois de formation militaire initiale.
